ask: Announce our new store hours on LinkedIn, X, Threads and our Facebook Page, with the full schedule as a comment on Facebook.

steps.why: Limits and needs for every network named, once.

posts.content: From Monday we open at 7 am. Earlier coffee for the commute crowd, same team behind the counter.
New hours from Monday: open 7 am.
Early birds, this one's for you: we open at 7 from Monday.

contents.content: New hours from Monday: we open at 7 am. Full schedule in the comments.
Mon-Fri 7 am to 6 pm. Sat 8 am to 4 pm. Sun closed.

steps.why: Each network wants its own shape, so one post per network, written fresh, in one bulk call. The Facebook item has two parts: part 2 goes out as a comment from the Page, so it is aimed at the Page alone. Then poll bulk-create-status: its posts list gives the Facebook and Threads post ids for the next steps.
bulk-create-posts keeps the Facebook account but not which Page, so a brand with several Pages would publish to its primary Page. update-post records the Page; leaving out content keeps both parts.
A setting only where it adds something; the user agreed to the topic.

say: Saved to Acme as 4 drafts: 1 LinkedIn, 2 X, 3 Threads (topic Coffee), 4 Facebook with the schedule as a comment under it. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule all 4 for Monday 7 am? Once they're out, I'll check the live Facebook post for the comment.
never: Pasting one text and trimming it per network.
Claiming the posts will look the same everywhere.
Saying the Facebook comment is live before checking the published post.
